title: Filing Acceptance Standards: Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing
content:
The acceptance standards below are set for every certificate of the Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing. They are identical across the Cardinal SR-22 Owner Certificate, Cardinal SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate, Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner Certificate, Cardinal Out-of-State SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate, Cardinal FR-44 Owner Certificate and Cardinal FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate.

| Standard | Setting on all six certificates |
|---|---|
| Filed driver must be a rated (not excluded) driver on the policy | Yes |
| Policy's coverage package must be marked eligible for SR-22 filings | Yes |
| Billing account's pay plan must be marked as allowing a financial-responsibility filing | Yes |
| Certificate effective date | The later of the request date and the policy term effective date |
| Certificate may be dated before the request date (backdating) | No |
| Active filings allowed for one driver with one ordering state | 1 |
| Details that must match the state order exactly | Full name, date of birth, license number, case number |
| Youngest driver Cardinal will file for | 16 years |

## Points of judgement

**Effective date.** The certificate's effective date is whichever is later: the date the filing is requested or the effective date of the policy term. *Hypothetical:* requested 10 May on a term effective 1 May, the certificate is effective 10 May; requested 20 April for a term effective 1 May, it is effective 1 May. Under this rule the certificate is never dated before the request date; backdating is not allowed.

**Matching.** Each of the four details is compared with the state order on its own; a difference in any one of them is a mismatch.

**Age.** A driver aged 16 or older can be filed for; Cardinal does not file for a driver younger than 16.
